What are healthy fats?: Healthy fats include unsaturated fats found in avocados, nuts, seeds, and olive oil.
What is BMI?: BMI stands for Body Mass Index, a measure of body fat based on height and weight.
Is cardio important for weight loss?: Yes, cardio can help burn calories and improve heart health, aiding in weight loss.
What is the best way to lose weight?: The best way to lose weight is through a combination of regular exercise and a healthy, calorie-controlled diet.
What is intermittent fasting?: Intermittent fasting is an eating pattern where you cycle between periods of eating and fasting.
How often should I work out?: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous activity each week.
How many calories should I eat to gain m: To gain muscle, you need a calorie surplus. A good starting point is adding 250–500 extra calories per day.
Should I eat before or after a workout?: It’s beneficial to eat both before and after a workout to fuel performance and recovery.
How much protein should I eat daily?: The recommended dietary allowance for protein is 0.8 grams per kilogram of body weight.
Are supplements necessary for fitness?: Supplements can help fill nutritional gaps but are not a replacement for a balanced diet.
